name: sbl-rows
note: Issues #196/#510: each band card is one Narrator stop, a ListItem with Invoke, named in visual order (rank, each member's name, instruments and score, then team score, full combo, accuracy and stars) and IDed fst.song-band-leaderboard.row.<band>:<rank>. Its rank, members, accuracy pill, instrument icons and star row stay out of the control view (raw view only), so scan mode never reads them twice (#510: StarRow ignored Raw and leaked '5 stars'). 40+ epx row target; header -> size switcher -> rows order; Down/Up move row to row, Enter opens Band Detail and Back returns.
after_ready: assertread:id=fst.song-band-leaderboard.row.fixture-band-1:1|Rank 1. Band 1 Member A, Lead, 94,500 points. Band 1 Member B, Bass, 94,000 points. Team score 94,500 points, full combo, 96.5% accuracy, 5 stars, list item

assertread:id=fst.song-band-leaderboard.row.fixture-band-2:2|Rank 2. Band 2 Member A, Lead, 94,000 points. Band 2 Member B, Bass, 93,500 points. Team score 94,000 points, 96.5% accuracy, 5 stars, list item

name: sbl-empty
note: Issues #196/#510: an empty size names its state on a UIA element (fst.song-band-leaderboard.empty, the level 2 empty heading; panels have no peer) followed by its message, after the size switcher; no list, pager or entry total is left behind.
after_ready: waitfor:name=No Trios scores have been recorded for this song yet.@3
assertorder:id=fst.song-band-leaderboard.song|id=fst.song-band-leaderboard.band-type-menu|id=fst.song-band-leaderboard.empty|name=No Trios scores have been recorded for this song yet.

name: sbl-error
note: Issues #196/#510: a failed read shows the shared service status (fst.service-status.title / .retry): the level 2 failure title, then a 40 epx Retry button, after the size switcher; Tab and Shift+Tab move between the size switcher and Retry.

name: sbl-accuracy-pill-contrast
note: Issues #196/#510: the band card's accuracy pill is navy by default and turns ButtonFace with a ButtonText outline under a contrast theme (FSTAccuracyPillFillBrush, FSTNeutralPillStrokeBrush), so its system-coloured text stays readable (Desert failed before #196). Switches Desert on and off in the running app.
